scenes.headline: What BioLLM-8B actually writes into Qwen3-8B
scenes.sub: The thread, the results file, and the controls
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Dendra. The company publishes a results file. Let's read that before the thread.

scenes.quote: patent-pending adapter that writes living human neuron activity into LLM layers
scenes.say: A patent-pending adapter that writes living human neuron activity into LLM layers.

scenes.credit: the explorer at biollm.com, screen recording

steps.caption: BioLLM-8B is built on Qwen3-8B
steps.say: The free chat is Qwen3-8B, frozen. The site says so, and its layer counts match.

steps.caption: Chat replays recorded rows
steps.say: And the chat does not touch live neurons. It replays rows recorded from two cultures, on the ninth and tenth of November.
The biology is real. Neurons grown on an electrode array can be stimulated and recorded, as DishBrain showed with Pong.
steps.term: MEA: an array of electrodes under the cells

steps.say: But DishBrain's claim rests on its controls: silent feedback, no feedback, rest.

scenes.title: A gain on every MLP neuron

params.dish: 428 electrode values per row, two cultures
params.gain: a gain on the activations entering down_proj
params.moved: every arm but one moves the words

steps.say: Here is the write. A few hundred electrode values from one recorded row, never the stimulated electrodes.
Fixed ties carry them to every MLP neuron, in all thirty-six layers.
steps.term: Oja's rule: a Hebbian update, no gradient

steps.say: Each neuron's activation is scaled before down projection, and the next word shifts.
Now swap in a shuffled row, or random ties. The words still move. Only the frozen model stays put.

scenes.title: Which of six cues was sent, culture 149
scenes.say: So test against controls. A symbol-trained write on the same rows recovers which of six cues the dish received: zero point four three. Shuffled, random and energy-only arms sit near chance.

scenes.title: The rest of the claim chain

steps.say: But on the newest session, the array mean alone separates the symbols. So the file will only say the device signal does.
An earlier letter-by-letter run failed its primary test.
Its adapter scored the same as sham.
And for the served adapter, the reply's wording tracks the culture on one dish, not the other. Both pre-stated rules failed.

items.say: The thread's connectome mapping is display geometry.
The quantum microtubules are a labelled model, out of scope.
And the Jacobian lens only reads.

scenes.text: A careful harness under a loud thread: the cue gets through, the neurons are not yet shown to carry it.
scenes.say: A careful harness under a loud thread. The cue gets through. That the neurons carry it is not yet shown.

recap: A cue readout beats its controls
scenes.say: To recap. A frozen model, replayed recordings, a readout that beats its controls, and an open question. Thanks for watching!
